messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: Sev2 - elevated 5xx/timeouts for inference route /v1/generate. Alert rule: gateway_5xx_rate > 1% (5m). Pager: oncall SRE. Incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1937 :rotating_light:
Alice (SRE): ack, I'm watching. initial spike at 09:14 UTC, 5xx ~ 3.6% cluster-wide, p95 from 120ms -> 1.2s. some 504s showing upstream timeout to model-serving.
Dinesh (Oncall): I'm on voice. quick check — control plane logs show a surge of KV cache evictions on shard kv-pref-07. seeing repeated `eviction: prefix_hit=false` across hosts.
Bob (Runtime): can you paste the eviction logs? suspect eviction storm causing backend timeouts due to excessive cache misses and backend thrash.
Dinesh (Oncall): pasted snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:14:21Z host=runtime-07 level=warn evict=512 prefix=0x7f3a kvcache_hits=0 kvcache_misses=256 eviction_reason=expire
2026-03-15T09:14:22Z host=runtime-07 level=error kv: checksum mismatch for prefix 0x7f3a -> corrupt_index
2026-03-15T09:14:23Z host=runtime-07 level=warn kvcache_miss_rate=0.92 requests_queued=120 backend_forward=timeout
```
Carla (Eng-ML): checksum mismatch + high miss rate looks like corruption on the prefix index rather than just eviction. If the runtime detects corruption it can fall back but that's causing synchronous backend reads -> latency spike.
Alice (SRE): immediate mitigation ideas: 1) disable prefix/KV caching on the affected shard(s) to prevent corrupt reads and force direct consistent reads 2) enable degraded routing (use model-variant fallback) 3) scale read replica count for the underlying store. We should do the least-risky first.
Bob (Runtime): I can flip cache to readonly for shard kv-pref-07 and enable bypass for prefixes. command (internal):
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/api/v0/admin/cache/toggle"
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
 -d '{"shard":"kv-pref-07","mode":"bypass"}'
```
Dinesh (Oncall): executing now on canary hosts (runtime-07a,b). will watch errors and latency.
Alice (SRE): ETA for change?
Dinesh (Oncall): pushed at 09:18 UTC.
incidents-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: cache toggle applied by Dinesh (Oncall) at 09:18 UTC. Change-id: chg-0x9f3.
Erin (Product): prepping status update. what's the customer impact numbers?
Alice (SRE): current metrics pre-change: 5xx = 3.6% (~12.1k errors/min across cluster), avg timeout ~ 450ms extra, impacted routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. Affected shard kv-pref-07 responsible for ~18% of traffic for that route.
Frank (Support): we're seeing ~60 customers opened tickets in last 20m. top affected: beta partners and a few enterprise tenants in eu-west.
Dinesh (Oncall): after canary bypass: on canary hosts 5xx dropped to 0.6%, p95 latency improved from 1.2s -> 360ms. rolling to remaining hosts in shard.
Bob (Runtime): good. we should still run consistency checks and replace corrupted index files. I'll spawn a repair job that will rebuild prefix index from KV store, but do it off-host to avoid further pressure.
Carla (Eng-ML): note: rebuild will increase backend reads; keep bypass until rebuild completes. consider committing a small routing rule so traffic to kv-pref-07 gets routed with higher concurrency limit to avoid queueing.
Alice (SRE): agreed. adding temporary routing policy now: route 100% of kv-pref-07->bypass. Also raising backend replica count by +1 for the underlying store.
incidents-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: routing policy added (route-1937-bypass) and replica scale +1.
Erin (Product): posting to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation of inference generation — elevated errors for some customers; mitigation in progress. We will update in 30m."
Frank (Support): sharing canned Slack snippet for customers and triage template.
Dinesh (Oncall): rebuild job kicked at 09:32 UTC (job-id rebuild-1937). running against snapshot to rebuild prefix index files. I expect 20-30m.
Alice (SRE): monitoring: cluster 5xx now down to 0.9% cluster-wide. per-route /v1/generate back to 0.7%. Still a small tail for streaming endpoints.
Bob (Runtime): watching logs — corruption warnings no longer emitted after bypass. good sign.
Carla (Eng-ML): checking evals and recent rollouts: no model changes coincident with spike, points to storage/index issue.
Erin (Product): ETA for full mitigation?
Dinesh (Oncall): rebuild progress: 45% at 09:48 UTC. error rate trending down.
Alice (SRE): plan for next hour: complete rebuild, verify checksums, re-enable prefix caching in staged rollout (10% -> 25% -> 100%). keep routing bypass until 25% is healthy.
Frank (Support): will keep support channel updated. customers with high impact flagged for escalation.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated=partial at 09:52 UTC. severity downgraded to Sev3.
Dinesh (Oncall): rebuild finished at 09:55 UTC. ran post-checks, all checksums green.
Bob (Runtime): starting staged re-enable of prefix cache: 10% traffic at 09:58 UTC.
Alice (SRE): monitoring closely. if errors spike >0.5% we rollback immediately.
incidents-bot: ROLLOUT: cache re-enable stage=10% started by Bob at 09:58 UTC.
Dinesh (Oncall): results: stage 10% stable for 6m, stage 25% started at 10:05 UTC.
Carla (Eng-ML): after 25% stable for 5m, scheduling final ramp.
Alice (SRE): ramp to 100% complete at 10:18 UTC. cluster 5xx steady at 0.15%.
Erin (Product): posted follow-up to status: "Issue mitigated, degraded routing removed; full service restored. A post-incident report will follow."
Frank (Support): closing high-impact tickets as resolved where customers confirm.
Alice (SRE): summary for handoff to night oncall: issue caused by prefix index corruption on shard kv-pref-07 causing eviction storm -> backend thrash -> elevated 5xx/timeouts. Mitigation: bypassed prefix cache, rebuilt index from snapshot, staged re-enable. Current state: healthy. Watchlist: shard kv-pref-07 for 24h, check `kvcache_miss_rate` and `checksum_errors`.
Dinesh (Oncall): handing off to Frank in 40m.
Frank (Support): ack, I'll take over post-mortem action items and customer follow-ups.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: incident marked resolved at 10:45 UTC (root cause: corrupted prefix index on shard kv-pref-07). postmortem owner: Frank (Support).
